Dedit autem Judas uxorem primogenito suo Her,
Then Judah gave a wife to his first born Er,
Fuit quoque Her primogenitus Judæ nequam in conspectu Domini: et ab eo occisus est.
And it also happened that Er, the first born of Judah, was wicked in the sight of the Lord and was killed by him.
Dixit ergo Judas ad Onan filium suum:
Therefore, Judah said to his son Onan:
“Enter to the wife of your brother,
so that you may raise offspring to your brother.”
Ille sciens non sibi nasci filios,
He, knowing that the sons to be born would not be his,
when he entered to the wife of his brother,
he spilled his seed on the ground,
lest children should be born in his brother’s name.
And for this reason, the Lord struck him down,
because he did a detestable thing.
Quam ob rem dixit Judas Thamar nurui suæ:
Because of this matter, Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar,
Esto vidua in domo patris tui,
“Be a widow in your father’s house,
until my son Shelah grows up.”
timebat enim ne et ipse moreretur,
For he was afraid, lest he also might die,
et habitavit in domo patris sui.
and she lived in her father’s house.
Then, after many days had passed,
mortua est filia Sue uxor Judæ:
the daughter of Shua, the wife of Judah,
And when he accepted consolation after his mourning,
he went up to the shearers of his sheep at Timnah,
ipse et Hiras opilio gregis Odollamites, in Thamnas.
he and Hirah, the herdsman of the Adullamite flock.
Nuntiatumque est Thamar quod socer illius ascenderet in Thamnas ad tondendas oves.
And it was reported to Tamar that her father-in-law had gone up to Timnah to shear the sheep.
And storing away the garments of her widowhood,
she took up a veil. And changing her clothing,
sedit in bivio itineris, quod ducit Thamnam:
she sat at the crossroad that leads to Timnah,
and she had not received him as a husband.
he thought her to be a harlot.
For she had covered her face,
And entering to her, he said,
nesciebat enim quod nurus sua esset.
For he did not know her to be his daughter-in-law.
Quid dabis mihi ut fruaris concubitu meo?
“What will you give to me, to enjoy me as a concubine?”
“I will send you a young goat from the flock.”
Patiar quod vis, si dederis mihi arrhabonem,
“I will allow what you want, if you give me a pledge,
until you may send what you promise.”
Quid tibi vis pro arrhabone dari?
“What do you want to be given for a pledge?”
et armillam, et baculum quem manu tenes.

Ad unum igitur coitum mulier concepit,
the woman, from one sexual encounter, conceived.
And she arose and went away.
And storing away the garments that she had taken up,
she was clothed in the garments of her widowhood.
Misit autem Judas hædum per pastorem suum Odollamitem,
Then Judah sent a young goat by his shepherd, the Adullamite,
ut reciperet pignus quod dederat mulieri:
so that he might receive the pledge that he had given to the woman.
But, when he had not found her,
he questioned the men of that place:
Ubi est mulier quæ sedebat in bivio?
“Where is the woman who sat at the crossroad?”
Non fuit in loco ista meretrix.
“There has been no harlot in this place.”
sed et homines loci illius dixerunt mihi,
the men of that place told me that a prostitute had never sat there.”
Judah said: “Let her hold herself to blame.
certe mendacii arguere nos non potest,
Certainly, she is not able to accuse us of a lie.
I sent the young goat that I had promised,
and you did not find her.”
Ecce autem post tres menses nuntiaverunt Judæ,
And behold, after three months, they reported to Judah,
Fornicata est Thamar nurus tua, et videtur uterus illius intumescere.

Quare divisa est propter te maceria?
